data_functions.description: 执行时读取现有未删除退票单，按源码状态选择一单；找不到符合条件数据则DATA失败，不伪造订单号。

statement.value: SELECT refund_serial_no, refund_state FROM saas_refund_order WHERE is_delete = 0 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1000
